display_name: Phase1 balanced posterior utility selector source pilot
description: Source-only weighted repair-vs-harm training variant of completed posterior utility pilot; weighted positive loss uses source training negative/positive ratio.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU2 source-only training, CPU 2 threads TF32 disabled; mixed L_s and U_s gradient preflight

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], six frozen class-conditional posterior waveform hypotheses; candidate F feature/probability, predicted noise and forward residual
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: Only L_s fit labels enter training; U_s uses high-confidence frozen clean F pseudo labels, no U_s truth, V or test
data.validation_ref: 384 fixed RX8 source heldout IDs, 64 per impaired view; previously explored, no true-label evaluation
data.leo_config_ref: Fresh source cache epoch21/22/23 training; source cache epoch19 evaluation

permissions.query_use: Only source fit L_s truth and U_s high-confidence clean F pseudo targets; no U_s truth/V/test
permissions.claim_scope: Source source IDs used by F and seen in other channel views, pseudo targets not independent test; bounded correction may exploit classifier

checkpoint.initialization: Random pairwise utility MLP; fixed blind source model, six class source priors and frozen F. DURA comparison after training only.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Blind action SHA256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338 and source prior SHA256 5e35516d54d3e3d1d1749933861f290c1f87c8ffdb4b863d2f9819914135ceb9
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 4096 source fit IDs, views21/22/23; minimum 100 source pairs with >=10 positives and negatives, 10 MLP epochs, final weight; source RX8 diagnostic thresholds .5/.75/.9. No target selection or automatic test.

execution.launch_owner: Codex source posterior utility pilot GPU2 owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 single owner, TF32 disabled, source-only training; real L_s/U_s gradient preflight

execution.stop_rule: Stop only for provenance or role violation, output collision, nonfinite values or technical failure; preserve partial output; never stop for low performance

metric_names: source pair positive and negative counts
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Source fit L_s truth or U_s pseudo targets; positive repair also requires paired source IQ error <=1.2x parent; no target labels at inference.

rows.method: input-only pairwise utility selector over six fixed class-conditional posterior IQ waveforms with balanced repair-pair loss
rows.purpose: test whether class imbalance explains zero-switch selector; fixed 0.5/0.75/0.9 thresholds
rows.seed_notes: 4096 source fit IDs disjoint from 8192 prior IDs, source fit/order seed 2026121355, MLP seed 2026121356
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.budget_ref: 4096 source fit IDs x 3 views to extract valid repair/harm pairs; 10 MLP epochs; 384 RX8 source probe

notes: Follow-up after observed zero switches in unweighted source pilot; positive class weight = training negative pairs / positive pairs; scores not calibrated; source-only, no test. Same source splits and fixed thresholds.
